name: NextForce youth program
what_you_do: Get free career planning, workshops, school support and work experience. Work experience can be paid or unpaid.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 24. Live in El Paso, Brewster, Culberson, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis or Presidio County. Be a U.S. citizen or allowed to work in the U.S. Males over 18 must be registered for Selective Service.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. Work experience can be paid or unpaid. Gas money, uniforms and child care help are free.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page. Contact NextForce to ask about starting.
how_to_apply: Check the list of who can join on the program page. Then email nextforce@borderplexjobs.com. The bottom of the site also lists 915-887-2600.
notes: The program page says its help is most useful for veterans and military spouses. It is also useful for youth in foster care and young adults who left high school. The page lists a hiring event on Nov 10, 2026 from 10 AM to 2 PM at Bassett Place. The event is called Hiring Red, White & You.
